long_biography.plain_text:
Abdullah Saleh Kamel studied economics at UCLA before joining Dallah Albaraka in 1988. He worked through property management, logistics and trade, later becoming president and chief executive of the diversified group founded by his father, Saleh Abdullah Kamel. That operating career preceded his appointment as chairman of Al Baraka Group in 2020, following years as vice-chairman and executive-committee leader.

Kamel now chairs Dallah Albaraka Holding and the banking group, whose network spans markets across the Middle East, North Africa and Asia. His wider governance includes KUN Investment Holding, Islamic-finance bodies and the Saleh Abdullah Kamel Humanitarian Foundation. The combination of long operating experience, substantial family shareholdings and institutional leadership makes him a steward of both commercial and charitable organizations.
